review_notes.evidence: Tight original root-literal-comparison-native.png and root-tight-glyphs-native.png confirm AD2B G05 (same form as AK/AL G05), AJ2G open-top H function, AK2H and BN4H U03HI. Native left-middle-original proves row34 +LATCHED SUM54/AP541BF4. Previous private quartet retained in before-root-literal-corrections; geometry unchanged.

All eleven direct-original card/pin contacts were read afresh. AC1D, AP3L, AR3N, AS5A and AT5B unnamed outputs visibly carry border wedges. BD6H function shares the open-top H form with BN4H/BP4J; BK7L literal function is UR. Four identifier-contact panels establish all 44 native printed identifiers independently. These AP554 source differences replace inherited AP474 fields.
Original AP554 44 card contacts and full footer/margins viewed. Same-TIFF border centers support ordinary 23-cell bank spacing. Final card is native 7L, moved one row above AP474 7M.

All 53 physical route groups compared against AP554 original in native quadrant overlays; 65 diamonds in six original contact sheets and 251 candidate unjoined crossing neighborhoods in eleven original contact sheets surveyed. Lower BV inputs independently inspected in tight original crop. See native-route-review-ledger.json. AP474 was only a comparison question list.
Same-TIFF function-comparison-contact-native.png shows AU4H and AV4J printed H (open upper center/bar), versus AS4F/AT4G printed closed-arch A. Preserve native H on AU/AV; AP474 differs.
Direct original footer reads FULL SUM CHECK/BITS48-55, DATE08-14-69, MACH7201-02, LOG153, FRAME02, P.NO2584564, IBM CORP. BLK. BW; revision08-08-69 713380. Right output AP555 +FULL SUM ERROR48-55.

AP474 internal navigation IDs are explicitly mapped to AP554 native printed IDs, see identifier-contact-1 through 4. Final physical output is BK4, not AP474 BV4. Metadata records comparison_page_id only as provenance; source identifiers are unique and drive final node/port names.
